pricing_policy: Harga belum diumumkan. Jangan tampilkan atau bebankan tarif tanpa persetujuan pemilik dan integrasi pembayaran produksi yang terverifikasi.
baseline_access_policy: SLI Open will offer only curated national overview and sector/news/map previews. Full national-series explorers, full strategic assets and original analytics will require authenticated Pro access after private migration. Official public statistical facts remain available at their original sources; provenance, glossary and general methodology are never hidden.

tiers.name: SLI Open
tiers.audience_id: Publik, mahasiswa, jurnalis, dan pengguna baru
tiers.audience_en: Public, students, journalists and first-time readers
features: Selected national Overview: key indicators and compact summary only, not SLI full national datasets
Short sector summaries; sampled news monitoring (up to five curated items)
SLI Research AI evidence search: curated public snippet preview with citations (no live generative model)
Strategic Map preview: limited public layers, selected asset samples, no detailed asset intelligence or downloads
Public glossary, general methodology, citations and basic navigation
Planned free account: one account / one active registered device

tiers.name: SLI Pro
tiers.audience_en: Researchers, analysts, consultants and individual investors
features: Everything in SLI Open
Full SLI national and sector data explorers, full Strategic Map, sector monitoring news and research archives
SLI Research AI full grounded Q&A on licensed/private corpus (future secure generative RAG)
Advanced 38-province analysis and cross-sector/provincial comparisons
Investment scenarios, econometrics and advanced research models (only as validated and released)
Advanced exports and original SLI analyst reports
One personal account / one active registered device, with secure replacement flow (planned)

tiers.name: SLI Enterprise
tiers.audience_id: Perusahaan, investor institusional, konsultan, tim riset
tiers.audience_en: Companies, institutional investors, consultancies and research teams
features: All SLI Pro capabilities
Managed team seats and workspaces, with seat count per contract (planned)
Custom source-grounded AI-assisted research reports with expert review under contract
Contract-based commissioned research, tailored strategic consulting and actionable sector advice within agreed legal scope
Weekly sector-specific monitoring reports with original bespoke analysis, risks, scenarios and recommendations per contract
Contracted briefings and expert support, plus special alerts where agreed
Datasets and redistribution only where SLI has lawful usage and source licensing rights

do_not_gate: Publicly sourced BPS/ESDM/PLN/BI datasets as such
Source URLs, original attribution and methodology
Public overview and basic navigational search
planned_gated_sli_views: Full SLI national datasets and data explorers
Detailed Strategic Map project and asset intelligence
Full curated sector news monitoring and archives
38-province comparisons, premium models, reports and exports

access_design.unauthenticated: Public landing, selected introductory previews and all source attribution; no premium entitlements.
access_design.open: Future free verified account, one active registered device at a time; selected Overview indicators, map/news samples, and introductory research only.
access_design.pro: Future paid verified account, one active registered device at a time; full SLI national/provincial dashboards, analytics and permitted export.
access_design.enterprise: Contracted named seats and managed workspace (not yet built); seat count and privileges follow signed contract.

device_policy.privacy: Consent-based revocable server-issued device session identifiers; no covert fingerprinting; users can revoke or replace their device.

open_preview_limits.national_data: Selected high-level indicator cards and snapshots; no full time-series explorer, full national database or bulk export through SLI Open.
open_preview_limits.strategic_map: Selected public map layers and a small illustrative asset sample; no complete asset details, advanced filters or data downloads.
open_preview_limits.news_monitoring: Curated sample of up to five headline cards; no complete sector feed, archives, intelligence filters or advanced alerts.
open_preview_limits.provincial_analysis: Overview summaries only; 38-province comparison, quantitative research and sector drill-down reserved for Pro.
open_preview_limits.terms: Glossary, non-exclusive definitions, sources and general methodology remain accessible.

research_ai.open_scope: Curated sourced evidence snippets and up to six citation cards per question; no full corpus access.
research_ai.pro_scope: Private licensed/owned SLI corpus, LLM-assisted synthesis with citations and validated scenario research, subject to launch.
research_ai.enterprise_scope: Custom research briefs and weekly sector monitoring with human review per signed agreement.
research_ai.privacy: Preview queries run only in-browser. Future private AI requires server-only keys, verified account entitlements, anti-abuse, and a privacy policy.
research_ai.security: No provider API token or premium dataset in GitHub Pages.
